Paragraph: "See Lakshmana, on that mountain terrace this peahen longing for love is dancing at the nearby of her husband, that peacock...
Situation/Problem_Faced: A peahen actively courting and dancing near her husband peacock on the mountain terrace.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama draws Lakshmana's attention to the intimate courtship behavior of the birds.
Outcome/Resolution: He notes the initiative and affection displayed by the female bird.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Loneliness: Pining for Affection, Observation of Intimacy

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Anuraga (Expressive romantic affection and devotion between partners)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: The peahen's loving dance around her husband depicts the natural, devoted impulse of the soul seeking proximity to its beloved.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Focusing on intimate pair interactions highlights inner relational grief and deep craving for emotional proximity.
